title: DeepSeek's Agent Harness Passed Claude Code in 5 Days
caption:
DeepSeek's agent harness has more GitHub stars than Claude Code. It is five days old.

dsh went public Aug 13: 150,696 stars, 15,472 forks, MIT, TypeScript. The README still calls it a developer preview.

I'll admit stars aren't installs, and I haven't moved a single real project onto it. But 150k clicks in five days says something about how thin the loyalty is in this category.

Would you switch harnesses?
